name: What does finish carpentry installation include?

mainEntity.name: What does finish carpentry installation include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish carpentry includes the visible wood elements installed after framing and drywall are complete. This work covers interior trim, baseboards, crown molding, door and window casings, wainscoting, interior doors, and custom built-in woodwork. Unlike rough framing, which creates the structural skeleton of a home, finish carpentry focuses on precision joints, smooth surfaces, and visual appeal. At HH Remodeling LLC, our crew handles these detailed woodwork elements alongside our drywall and painting services, ensuring clean transitions where wood meets finished walls. Choosing comprehensive finish work ties together your overall interior design and provides durable protection for wall bases and door openings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish carpentry covers visible, detailed woodwork installed after drywall, including baseboards, crown molding, door casings, interior doors, and custom decorative trim.
